{{Quote|Ka'Pa's agents said Takara's lieutenant Abron Mar hangs out at the spaceport cantina. Hope when I find him, I can convince him to be cooperative... Now if I can just find the cantina, AND avoid all the unsavory characters along the way...|Mara Jade|audio=KatraasiiSpaceportIntro.flac|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
A '''cantina''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Katraasii]], located in the [[Katraasii Spaceport]], was the favored hangout of [[Abron Mar]],  lieutenant of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Takara]]'s [[Takara's organization|organization]]. Found atop a flight of stairs, the [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] boasted two dining rooms, one with a bar worked by a lone bartender. It hosted a variety of [[Human/Legends|Human]] and [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] patrons as well as Mar's [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Gangster/Legends|henchmen]]. The cantina entertained guests by serving drinks and playing songs like the "[[Dune Sea Special/Legends|Dune Sea Special]]" over speakers. Some ugnaughts and a [[Grave Tuskens|Grave Tusken]] could be found loitering outside the doorway.<ref name="MOTS" />

[[File:Abron Mar Headshot.png|thumb|right|150px|Abron Mar, a regular]]
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="TNEC" /> Mar visited the cantina to quench his thirst. However, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] followed him, [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|searching]] for Mar on behalf of Takara's rival, [[Ka'Pa]] [[Hutt/Legends|the Hutt]]. To prevent Mar from leaving the planet if he left the cantina, Jade grounded [[Abron Mar's R-41 Starchaser|his Starchaser]]. After navigating through the crowded main hall, Jade confronted Mar by the cantina's bar, but he ran down a triangular hallway and escaped through a locking back door, leaving his henchmen to handle Jade. Once she [[Death/Legends|dispatched]] the thugs, [[Dark Empire|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] ran through the cantina and attacked Jade as other patrons fled.<ref name="MOTS" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I got to put no less than THREE cantinas in the mission (and this is where I discovered that there are no "bars" in Star Wars... only cantinas.)|Ryan Kaufman, on designing the Katraasii Spaceport levels|<ref name="BTS blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
This cantina appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> Level designer [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] created the expansive streets of Katraasii Spaceport, including this cantina.<ref name="BTS blog" />
